findings.defect: Two concurrently active supported local jobs can fail A then B, and the managed runner overwrites its stored fatal value so the terminal rejection returns B instead of the documented first fatal A.
findings.formalGap: WorkOnceRuntime.ActiveDone and WorkOnceLocalRunner.ActiveDone also replaced their representative fatal value on every later unhandled active failure, so the abstraction represented the same incorrect overwrite and could not prove first-fatal preservation.
